import datetime as dt

import pytest

import humanize


@pytest.mark.parametrize("delta, min_unit, expected", [
    (dt.timedelta(days=153), "seconds", "5 months"),
    (dt.timedelta(days=33), "seconds", "1 month and 2 days"),
    (dt.timedelta(days=396), "seconds", "1 year and 1 month"),
    (dt.timedelta(days=31, hours=3), "seconds", "1 month and 3 hours"),
    (dt.timedelta(days=92), "hours", "3 months"),
])
def test_whole_months_leave_no_half_day(delta, min_unit, expected):
    assert humanize.precisedelta(delta, minimum_unit=min_unit) == expected
